name: Compress PDF
tagline: Make PDFs smaller, or keep only the first page. Your files never leave this device.
description: Make a PDF smaller for free, right in your browser. Files are never uploaded. Pick the quality, or keep only the first page. No sign-up.

specs.First load: 16 MB, then cached by your browser
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The compressor is Ghostscript compiled to WebAssembly, served from this site and run inside your browser tab. The page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere. Once the page has loaded you can go offline and it still works.
Balanced suits email and sharing. Smallest suits reading on screen. Print keeps images sharp enough for paper. Prepress keeps colour profiles for professional printing.

faq.q: Why did my file get bigger?
faq.a: PDFs made mostly of text and vector drawings are often already compact. Ghostscript rewrites the whole file, so the result can come out slightly larger. Keep the original in that case.
